name: Relaxed Connectivity Voxelization
definition: A voxelization technique for effectively one-dimensional input that produces a 26-connected path, allowing for fewer voxels than 6-connected methods while still maintaining connectivity.
summary: Relaxed Connectivity Voxelization produces 26-connected voxel grids from effectively 1D primitives, ensuring topological continuity for flow simulations while supporting 2D and 3D inputs unlike standard methods.
